Luke wrote carefully so Theophilus could have certainty. How does knowing the gospel is grounded in history help your faith?
Zechariah doubted the angel's message even while serving in the temple. Why is it sometimes hard to believe God's promises?
Mary said, "Let it be to me according to your word." What would it mean for you to say this to God?
Mary's song praises God for lifting up the humble. What has God done that you can praise him for?
Zechariah sang that God has visited and redeemed his people. Where have you seen God's mercy visit you?
The Son of God was born and laid in a manger. What does his humble birth tell you about him?
The good news came first to shepherds. Why might God choose to announce it to ordinary people?
Simeon and Anna waited many years for the Messiah. What helps you wait faithfully on God?
The boy Jesus said he must be in his Father's house. What does this show about who he is?
John's ministry fulfilled Isaiah: "All flesh shall see the salvation of God." Why is this good news for everyone?
John told people to share, be honest and be content. What would repentance look like in your daily work?
John said he was not worthy to untie Jesus' sandals. How does his humility speak to you?
At Jesus' baptism the Father says, "With you I am well pleased." What does this show about the Father's love for the Son?
Luke traces Jesus' line all the way back to Adam. Why might it matter that Jesus is connected to all humanity?
Jesus answered every temptation with God's word. Which temptation do you face, and what Scripture could help?
Jesus read that he came to bring good news to the poor and freedom to captives. Where do you need his freedom?
His hometown turned against him. Why do people reject Jesus when he challenges them?
People were amazed at his authority over evil. What does this show about Jesus' power?
Even when crowds wanted him to stay, Jesus kept to his mission. What is God's purpose for you right now?
Peter said, "At your word I will let down the nets." Where do you need to obey Jesus even when it doesn't make sense?
Peter felt unworthy, but Jesus said, "Do not be afraid." How does Jesus meet you in your unworthiness?
Even as crowds grew, Jesus withdrew to pray. How can you make room for prayer in a busy season?
The friends lowered the paralysed man through the roof. Who can you bring to Jesus?
Levi left everything and threw a feast for Jesus. How does following Jesus change what we do with what we have?
Jesus healed on the Sabbath and asked, "Is it lawful to do good?" How does this shape how you use your rest days?
Jesus prayed all night before choosing the twelve. What decision do you need to bring to God in prayer?
Jesus blesses the poor and the hungry. What does this show about what God values?
"Be merciful, even as your Father is merciful." Who needs your mercy this week?
Jesus speaks of the log in your own eye. Where might you be judging others too quickly?
Jesus asks, "Why do you call me 'Lord, Lord,' and not do what I tell you?" What is he telling you to do?
The centurion trusted Jesus' word from a distance. What does his faith teach you?
Jesus had compassion on the widow and said, "Do not weep." What does this show about how Jesus sees grief?
John asked from prison, "Are you the one?" How does Jesus answer doubts?
The woman who was forgiven much loved much. How has knowing you are forgiven shaped your love for Jesus?
The good soil holds fast the word with an honest heart and bears fruit with patience. How can you be that kind of soil?
"Take care then how you hear." How do you listen to God's word?
Jesus asked, "Where is your faith?" How would you answer during your own storms?
The healed man was sent home to tell what God had done. What could you share about what God has done for you?
Jesus stopped for the woman, then said to Jairus, "Do not fear; only believe." What fear do you need to give him?
Jesus sent the twelve to proclaim and heal. How can you share in Jesus' work this week?
Five loaves and two fish fed thousands. What small thing can you give Jesus to use?
Peter answered, "The Christ of God." Who do you say Jesus is?
Jesus says to take up your cross daily. What does that mean for you today?
On the mountain the Father said, "This is my Son, my Chosen One; listen to him!" What do you need to hear from Jesus?
Jesus set his face to go to Jerusalem. What does true commitment to following him look like?
Jesus said the harvest is plentiful but the labourers few. What part can you play?
Jesus told them to rejoice that their names are written in heaven. Why is this the greatest joy?
The Samaritan showed mercy to a stranger. Who is your neighbour this week?
Martha was distracted while Mary sat at Jesus' feet. What distracts you from being with him?
The disciples asked, "Lord, teach us to pray." Which part of this prayer do you most need today?
Jesus teaches us to ask, seek and knock. What do you need to keep asking God for?
Jesus said, "Whoever is not with me is against me." What does wholehearted loyalty to Jesus look like?
Jesus said, "Blessed rather are those who hear the word of God and keep it!" How can you keep what you read today?
Jesus warned against being clean outside but not inside. What needs cleaning within you?
God does not forget even sparrows, and you are worth more. How does this speak to your fears?
The rich fool built bigger barns but was not rich toward God. What would being rich toward God look like for you?
Jesus says, "Do not be anxious," because the Father knows what you need. What worry can you hand over?
The servant is blessed whom the master finds ready. What does being ready look like for you?
The gardener asked for one more year for the fig tree. What does this show about God's patience with us?
Jesus freed a woman bent over for eighteen years. What has kept you bent over, and can you bring it to him?
The kingdom grows like a mustard seed and yeast. Where do you see God at work in small ways?
Jesus says to strive to enter through the narrow door. What does that mean for you?
Jesus longed to gather Jerusalem like a hen gathers her brood. What does this show about his heart?
Jesus healed on the Sabbath despite watching eyes. What does this teach about compassion over appearances?
Jesus says to take the lowest seat. Where can you practise humility this week?
Jesus says to invite those who cannot repay you. Who could you welcome?
The master invited the poor and the outcast to his feast. How are you responding to God's invitation?
Jesus says to count the cost of following him. What does it cost you?
The shepherd leaves the ninety-nine to find the one. What does this show about how God sees the lost?
Heaven rejoices over one sinner who repents. Why does God rejoice so much?
The father ran to his returning son. What does this show about how God welcomes you?
The older brother refused to join the party. Where might you resent God's grace to others?
"You cannot serve God and money." Which one shapes your choices more?
Jesus says faithfulness in little leads to being trusted with much. Where can you be faithful in small things?
The rich man ignored Lazarus at his gate. Who might be at your gate that you overlook?
Abraham said people who won't listen to Scripture won't be convinced even by a resurrection. How seriously do you take God's word?
Jesus says to forgive even seven times in a day. Who do you find it hardest to forgive?
The apostles asked, "Increase our faith!" What does Jesus' answer teach about faith?
Jesus speaks of servants simply doing their duty. How does this guard us against pride?
Only one of the ten came back to give thanks. What can you thank Jesus for today?
Jesus says the kingdom of God is in your midst. Where do you see God's reign today?
Jesus told this parable so that we would always pray and not lose heart. What prayer do you need to keep praying?
The tax collector prayed, "God, be merciful to me, a sinner!" What does his prayer teach about coming to God?
Jesus welcomed the children. How do you receive the kingdom like a child?
The rich ruler couldn't let go of his wealth. What might you be holding too tightly?
The blind man cried out and Jesus asked, "What do you want me to do for you?" How would you answer?
Jesus said to Zacchaeus, "Today salvation has come to this house." What changed in Zacchaeus, and why?
"The Son of Man came to seek and to save the lost." How have you experienced Jesus seeking you?
The servants were given money to use until the master returned. What has God entrusted to you?
Jesus said if the people were silent, the stones would cry out. What moves you to praise him?
Jesus wept over Jerusalem. What does his grief show about his heart for people?
The leaders questioned Jesus' authority. Do you accept his authority over your life?
The tenants rejected the owner's son. What does this parable reveal about God's patience?
"Render to God the things that are God's." What belongs to God in your life?
Jesus says God is the God of the living. What hope does this give you about life beyond death?
Jesus warned against religious show. How can you guard against wanting to be seen?
The widow gave more than all the others. What does God see when you give?
Jesus says, "By your endurance you will gain your lives." What helps you endure?
Jesus says to straighten up and raise your heads because redemption is near. What hope does this give you?
"My words will not pass away." How do Jesus' words steady you in a changing world?
Jesus warns that hearts can be weighed down by the cares of life. What weighs your heart down?
At the Last Supper Jesus said, "Do this in remembrance of me." What do you remember about Jesus when you share the Lord's Supper?
The disciples argued about greatness, and Jesus said, "I am among you as the one who serves." Where can you serve?
Jesus prayed that Peter's faith would not fail. What comfort is it that Jesus prays for you?
In the garden Jesus prayed, "Not my will, but yours, be done." Where do you need to pray this?
After denying Jesus, Peter saw the Lord look at him. What do you think was in that look?
Pilate found no guilt in Jesus but handed him over. Why did Jesus go to the cross though innocent?
Simon of Cyrene carried the cross behind Jesus. What does it mean for you to follow behind Jesus?
Jesus prayed, "Father, forgive them." What does this teach you about forgiveness?
Jesus promised the criminal, "Today you will be with me in paradise." What does this show about grace?
Jesus said, "Father, into your hands I commit my spirit!" What does it mean to entrust yourself to God?
The angels asked, "Why do you seek the living among the dead?" What difference does the risen Jesus make to you?
Jesus explained how all the Scriptures pointed to him. How does seeing Jesus throughout the Bible help you read it?
Their hearts burned as Jesus opened the Scriptures. When has God's word warmed your heart?
Jesus said, "Peace to you!" and showed his hands and feet. What does his real, bodily resurrection mean?
Jesus sent them to proclaim repentance and forgiveness to all nations. How can you be a witness this week?
